facts.fact: Namibia Statistics Agency told the SADC workshop that an MoU with the labour ministry (MLIREC) provides for a steering committee and technical working group on data sharing, but no law or MoU yet covers access to immigration records and no administrative statistics are published from them.
Namibia Statistics Agency presents 2023 census results giving a population of 3,022,401, of whom 145,395 are non-Namibians.
